title: The Horizon of the Rust Belt
author: Rafael Ishikawa
blurb: Petra Villalobos, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
